title: Elton Theodore's age and address
summary: Answering Dick's questions, Valentine says banjoist Elton Theodore is older than he is, about 63-65, and has moved from his old address.

blocks.x: Well, anyway, you may think of it. I was going to, there's a couple of questions here. Dick asked me to find out.
One is about Elton Theodore. How old is he? We might have asked you before.
Wait, let me see, let me see how old Elton.
Oh, he is older than me, yes sir. He is older than me. He must be around about 60, 63, 64, 65, something like that.

Well, I got his address at home. I got the address at home. I think I got that address at home. See, when we had this band here, we were living on Wyatt Street, you see? But now he don't live there no more now. He moved from there, you see? Oh yeah. Uh huh, yeah, he moved from there. I always can get that address from there, you see? Yeah, we all got that.
